If you need help with this project, here are the various ways you can get support:

Check out the project documentation in the README.md file and any other documentation files in the repository.

For bugs and feature requests, please [create an issue](https://github.com/Alicehhhmm/norush.me/issues/new/choose) in the repository.

## Contact
